invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of the add method, which should never be null.
The result is a Cell containing a Label, so the actor should be non-null.
The actor placed in the cell is always a Label per method construction.
labelStyleName is used to look up a style in the skin, so it should be non-null to avoid NPE.
The Label in the cell is always created with the style from the skin for the given labelStyleName.
